title: sph-map 11.8.0: spherical-harmonic Fourier filtering of crystallographic electron-density maps (code for Panjikar, Weiss & Jayatilaka, Acta Cryst. A)
description: sph-map multiplies each phased crystallographic Fourier coefficient by a real spherical harmonic of the reciprocal-lattice direction and writes the filtered coefficients and maps. This release is the version used in Panjikar, Weiss & Jayatilaka, Directional analysis of electron-density maps by spherical-harmonic Fourier filtering (Acta Cryst. A, submitted), and contains the scripts that reproduce every number, table and figure of that paper. The input data are archived in a separate Zenodo record together with the same scripts (see related identifiers).
